			NOT = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:hero_cult_aspect }
			NOT = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:imperial_cult_aspect }
		}
		localization_key = SVX_N_HELLENIZATION_003
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = empty_text
	}
}
